content: Empirical (pdfplumber 0.11.10 vs pypdf 6.21 on a synthetic two-column page): pdfplumber default extract_text interleaves the two columns line by line; pypdf follows content-stream order. pdfplumber expands ligatures by default (U+FB01 -> fi; expand_ligatures=False keeps them); pypdf keeps U+FB01. The two extractors therefore produce different text for the same page; a quote verified against one may fail against the other.
